Vendored isolation vectors for DOG-29 / DOG-22.

Canonical copy: barzoj-co/llmentary testdata/isolation/*.json
(proxy PR https://github.com/barzoj-co/llmentary/pull/35,
branch cursor/dog-29-isolation-spec-f2b6; testdata/isolation/README.md
is the spec note on that branch).

tests/test_isolation_vectors.py compares this directory to that path,
trying the PR branch first and then v{PROXY_VERSION}. CI fetches the
same path during the proxy-install step (one secret-bearing step).
